description.narrative:
Det övergripande målet med insatsen är att öka den ekonomiska tillväxten på den bergiga albanska landsbygden genom utveckling av marknadssystemet för medicinska och aromatiska växter (MAPs) och andra skogsprodukter genom: i) förbättrad produktivitet av MAPs; ii) hållbara pro-poor affärsmodeller för MAPs marknadsaktörer i den privata sektorn; iii) möjliggöra för miljöpolicyer och regelverk att främja rättvisa och hållbara metoder.
Insatsens totala budget på 26 miljoner kronor kommer att finansieras av Sida.

The overall goal of the contribution is to enhance economic growth of rural mountainous Albania through the development of the marketing system for Medical Aromatic Plants (MAPs) and other forest produce, to be achieved through: I) Improved MAPs productivity; ii) sustainable pro-poor business models of MAPs private sector market actors; iii) Enabling environment policies and regulations to promote fair and sustainable practices.
The total budget of intervention of 26 Million SEK will be funded by Sida.

The overall objective of the project is to increase the incomes of households in rural Albania by promoting improvements in the efficiency and inclusiveness of the Medical Aromatic Plants (MAPs) and other Non Timber Forest Products (NTFPs) market system. The specific objective is to promote sustainable and resilient business and inclusive access to benefits for MAPs and other NTFP products in rural Albania. This will be achieved by designing and implementing a set of interventions aiming to address the problems and contraits faced by MAPs producers. The project will use the Market System Development (MSD) approach. The expected outcomes of the project are: Outcome 1: Improved MAPs (and other NTFPs) productivity. Outcome 2: MAPs (and other NTFPs) private sector market actors have sustainable pro poor business models. Outcome 3: Enabling environment policies and regulations promote fair and sustainable practices.

description.narrative:
Results achieved during 2025 are the following:
- Testing and introduction of new drying and storage technologies. One Partnership Agreement (PA) with the exporter Agroherbal to install a solarassisted dryer using the combination of the solar collector and heat pump system using biomass for winter period in an area of 200 m2 with drying capacity of about 2 tons per 24 hours (60 tons per month) serving over 200 farmers in Lac/ Mamurras. - Upgrading of local processing capabilities and promotion of local value addition. One PA with GBE company operating in Trana for the instalment of a new processing line was completed in September, allowing them to produce more than ten different teas using different MAPs varieties. All products are according to international market demands and standards GBE extended its cooperation with farmers, consolidators and end market clients by setting up new standards and certification. One PA with Vera Ceco company in Delvina, south of Albania to support an investment in a solar power installation covering the whole roof of their facility. This investment enabled the company to have a constant and permanent energy supply with energy zeroing the costs and improving MAPs processing line which is not being uses to insufficient power. - Promotion of cultivation of high biodiversity value and market demanded MAPs. One PA signed with Rrodhe company in Gramshi to plant 2 ha of land area with primula veris seedlings supporting 10 farmers in Gramshi municipality. One PA signed with Qemal Tahiri company in Kukes to plant 5 hectares of land area with Gentiana Lutea seedlings supporting 5 farmers in Kukes municipality. - Promoting MAPs NTFPs innovation: Mycoforestry CNVP commissioned IDForest, a Spanish firm specialized in applied forest mycology, to assess the potential for sustainable wild mushroom production in Albania focused on the Pukë region. - Promoting Wood Biomass Energy CNVP contracted an Austrian service provider, Agrarplus, to complete a feasibility study to assess the potential to introduce modern wood biomass heating systems in public buildings several in two local municipalities FushëArrës & Has. - Continue to support the promotion of Albanian MAPs at national and international level. Four companies with project support participated in the Agricultura Fair in Lushnja, Albania to promote products, network and exchange.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
